What we do

Information, technology, and tools.

NTREIS provides information management services to 53,000+ MLS subscribers across its 13 Shareholder REALTOR® Associations, including more than 9,000 real estate offices.

In addition to its information management platform, NTREIS researches, develops, and delivers technology products and services through strategic alliances.
